The price is down 25% in that window and 56% off its 30-minute high, so the coin already gave back most of its run. The curve data points to concentration: bundled wallets held 72% of curve activity, and the top three accounts took 13%. A launch bot was present. That is not organic demand; it is a structure where a few wallets can exit into whoever arrives late.

The one positive is that the coin is alive, has no airdrop-dump flag, and the classifier labels it ORGANIC. But that label conflicts with the bundle share and launch-bot presence, and organic labels have not rescued a coin that is already in a 56% drawdown with flat net flow.
